useCases: Local Request Relay , routes Postman web requests through your machine so localhost, intranet, and VPN-only endpoints respond normally.
CORS Bypass , sends requests outside the browser sandbox so cross-origin APIs stop failing with preflight errors.
Tray-Resident Service , runs quietly in the notification area and starts with Windows so the web app connects on first load.
readmeSummary: Postman Agent is a background helper application that lets the Postman web interface send real HTTP requests from your Windows machine.
